verdict.rationale: Drata, a compliance SaaS platform rather than an agent, has an official MCP server documented in a first-party 'Drata MCP — Setup & Usage Guide' help article, confirmed by a probe. Its docs also say it enables AI agents to interact with Drata via natural language. The evidence consists only of titles and short blurbs, so setup steps, auth, exposed tools and supported clients are unproven. missing for 10: documented setup and connection details, auth/permission scoping for the MCP server, list of exposed tools and capabilities, supported MCP clients, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Enable AI agents to interact with Drata
